name: Cornelius van Poelenburgh

summary.text: Cornelis van Poelenburgh or Cornelis van Poelenburch, was a Dutch landscape painter and draughtsman. He was the leading representative of the first generation of Dutch landscape painters who were active in Rome in the early 17th century.
summary.title: Cornelis van Poelenburgh
